en.headline: Red Rainstorm Warning issued; morning and whole-day classes suspended
en.dek: The Observatory upgraded to a Red Rainstorm Warning at 5:05 a.m., with a Thunderstorm Warning in force until 8:30 a.m., and the Education Bureau suspended morning and whole-day school classes.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Red Rainstorm Warning Signal at 5:05 a.m. on Thursday, indicating that heavy rain exceeding 50 millimetres in an hour has fallen or is expected generally over Hong Kong and is likely to continue. The Thunderstorm Warning remains in force and has been extended until 8:30 a.m., with occasional squally thunderstorms expected.

The Observatory said further heavy rain could cause serious road flooding and traffic congestion. Flash floods are possible and flooding is occurring or expected in watercourses. People were advised to stay away from watercourses, and residents living close to rivers were told to consider evacuation if their homes may flood.

The Education Bureau said all morning and whole-day schools are suspended. Schools were told to implement contingency arrangements and look after any students who have already arrived, and to send pupils home only when it is safe. If the Observatory issues an Amber Rainstorm Warning or cancels all rainstorm signals at or before 10:30 a.m., afternoon-school classes will proceed as usual unless otherwise advised.

The Labour Department said employers should make work arrangements for staff as soon as possible. The Drainage Services Department asked the public to report street flooding. At 6 a.m. the Observatory recorded 26 degrees Celsius and 96 per cent relative humidity, with lightning detected across the territory and heavier rainfall reported in Sai Kung, the Islands District and parts of Kowloon and Hong Kong Island.

zh.headline: 天文台改發紅色暴雨警告 上午校及全日制學校停課
zh.dek: 天文台今晨5時05分改發紅色暴雨警告，雷暴警告有效至上午8時30分；教育局宣布所有上午校及全日制學校今日停課。
body: 香港天文台於周四上午5時05分發出紅色暴雨警告信號，表示香港廣泛地區已錄得或預料會有每小時雨量超過50毫米的大雨，且雨勢可能持續。雷暴警告仍然生效，並延長至上午8時30分，預料本港間中有狂風雷暴。
天文台表示，持續暴雨已經或將會導致道路嚴重水浸和交通擠塞，亦可能影響學校上課時間。大雨可引發山洪暴發，河道已經或可能氾濫，市民應遠離河道；河道附近居民如住所可能水浸，應考慮撤離。
教育局上午5時30分公布，因紅色暴雨警告生效，所有上午校及全日制學校今日停課。學校應實施應急措施，照顧可能已返抵校園的學生，並只在安全情況下才讓學生回家。若天文台於上午10時30分或之前改發黃色暴雨警告或取消所有暴雨警告，除非另行通知，下午校將照常上課。
勞工處呼籲僱主盡早作出僅員工作安排。渠務署呼籲市民如發現街道水浸，盡快報告。天文台上午6時錄得氣溫26度、相對濕度96%，各區均有閃電記錄，西貢、離島及九龍、港島部分地區雨量較大。
